target_pattern: Use poner across placement, commands, subjunctive triggers, indirect-object food and drink frames, emotional impact, and pronominal ponerse for becoming or putting on clothing.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Treating poner as only to put and translating each use literally.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Poner is a flexible high-frequency frame across several constructions, and ponerse changes meaning to become or put on.
target_pattern_formula: preterite placement: puse pusiste puso pusimos pusieron
commands: pon no pongas ponga no ponga
indirect object frame: que le pusiste a and le puse
emotional impact: me puso triste or me ponen nervioso
pronominal: ponerse plus adjective or clothing
natural_examples: Pon las maletas en el coche.
Que le pusiste a la sopa?
Me puse nervioso antes de la reunion.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Puse las llaves en la mesa. -> change subject to tu.
Base: Pusimos los platos en la mesa. -> change object to las tazas.
Base: Pon la ropa en la cama. -> make it negative tu command.
Base: Ponga las maletas en el coche. -> change to tu affirmative.
Base: No pongas eso en el garaje. -> change to usted negative.
Base: Quieres que ponga la mesa? -> change subject in subordinate clause to ellos.
Base: Quieres que pongamos la ropa en la lavadora? -> change object to los zapatos.
Base: Que le pusiste a la sopa? -> change noun to al cafe.
Base: Le puse sal. -> change ingredient to limon.
Base: La pelicula me puso feliz. -> change adjective to triste.
Base: Las mentiras me ponen furioso. -> change subject to singular la mentira.
Base: Me puse feliz al verte. -> change emotion to nervioso.
Base: Ella se puso un vestido rojo. -> change clothing to la chaqueta negra.
Base: Nos ponemos los abrigos en invierno. -> change season to cuando hace frio.
Base: Te pusiste triste ayer. -> turn into question form.

prompts: I put the keys on the table. (Puse las llaves en la mesa. vs Ponia las llaves en la mesa.)

common_errors.mistake: ponia for a completed put event
common_errors.why_it_happens: Imperfect used instead of completed preterite.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use preterite forms such as puse or puso.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Negative command built from affirmative stem.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use no pongas or no ponga.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Subjunctive trigger not applied after quieres que.
Missing indirect-object structure for container nouns.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use que le pusiste a la sopa.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Wrong clitic selected for indirect object.

common_errors.mistake: me puso triste when present habitual is intended
common_errors.why_it_happens: Tense mismatch in emotional impact pattern.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use me pone triste for habitual present.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Reflexive pronoun omitted in become meaning.
Wrong pronoun placement in affirmative reflexive command.

common_errors.mistake: adjective agreement ignored in poner plus adjective
common_errors.why_it_happens: Not matching adjective with affected person.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Match adjective agreement, for example nos puso nerviosos.

common_errors.mistake: random mix of poner and ponerse
common_errors.why_it_happens: Transitive and pronominal meanings not separated.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use poner for placing objects and ponerse for becoming or putting on.
